description: An event truly anonymous, no link to a user
title: Anonymous Event

properties.description: List of all the possible event properties. DO NOT Change. Automatically generated during build

then.description: Reveal of a field in vault item, at detail /edit view and not at creation. Reasons : this is to compare with autofill volumes, and is not significant at creation.

When Dashlane suggests to autofill some data field (eg. address, credit_card, website) with an extension webcard (or with the Android dropdown/keyboard suggestions (eg. autofill/keyboard/suggestion and autofill/dropdown/suggestion)) or to save/replace a password with a webcard.
When Dashlane detects a phishing attempt on a user.
When Dashlane suggests the user to authenticate with a passkey on a website.
Redirection of user triggered by a phishing attempt
Ping event for integration test
Sent when the Antiphishing alert has been shown and completed prediction and scraping.
When the user submits a form (login, registration, save payment, etc.).
Dismiss autofill
Details of when a user removes an OTP code from one of their credentials
When the user right clicks in a field, the right click menu appears. This event tracks the actions taken by the user in the right click menu from the the moment he triggers it.
When the user successfully removes an OTP code from the Authenticator app
When the user launches the Authenticator app for the first time, collect the other authenticator app installed. Sent only at first launch and strictly only once
When the user successfully adds an OTP code from the Authenticator app
When Dashlane suggests the user to register a new passkey on a website.
Open an external link on a vault item field

Report sent following a scan of the security of a master password which is performed every 2 weeks. Notably, it checks whether the master password can be found on the dark web. This is separate from the Dark Web Monitoring feature.
When the user copies a field from the application.
Sent when a user restores their password to its previous version after being proposed to do so by Dashlane (e.g. after a potential automatic password change failure).
Details of when a user adds an OTP code to one of their credentials. Item information can be empty because the user can start adding an OTP code before a credential is created.

When the user makes a correction on a field filled by Dashlane with autofill. There are 4 types of corrections possible (erase, edit, change classification, overwrite). Specifically, when a user changes the classification of field, for example from email to phone, the next time he changes the classification of the field, the value for field_corrected will be phone.

It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. Sent every time an attempt to update a credential with Password Changer is done. To be precise, the date of the event correspond to the moment the recipe has finished to run, not when it has started.
Autofill by Dashlane, for anonymous side
Event sent on extension install or extension updates, initially sent for devices that have been mass deployed and are protected by CRD.
A credential was updated in the vault
When the user accepts a suggestion made by Dashlane.

Sent every time the user starts (e.g. by clicking on a change password button in Android autofill), cancels, or completes a guided password change (the credential is successfully updated in the vault). This happens when the automatic password changer is not available.
Autofill disable setting modified.
Sent when the autofill engine has finished to inject icons in the autofillable fields identified in the page.
When the password generated within the webcard is validated by the user
